verdict.rationale: Expensify documents a public Integration Server API, but the evidence describes it only as a way to download report data and provision accounts. Expensify also offers cards with Smart Limits, yet nothing shows that cards can be created, locked, or have their controls updated through the API. Card limits set in the product UI and generic API credentials are adjacent features and earn no credit for programmatic card issuance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API
